name: WeCom
description: Connect WeCom for contacts, messages, documents, calendars, meetings, and todos.
authorization.title: Connect a WeCom bot
authorization.description: An administrator configures the WeCom bot ID and secret. Poco establishes each user's connection from that configuration and manages access tokens.
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.contacts.title: Contacts and messages
capabilities.contacts.description: Look up visible members, chats, and messages, and send text messages.
capabilities.collaboration.title: Calendars, meetings, and todos
capabilities.collaboration.description: Create, inspect, update, and cancel calendars and meetings, and manage todos.
capabilities.documents.title: Documents and sheets
capabilities.documents.description: Read and write documents, online sheets, smart sheets, and smart pages.
capabilities.safety.title: Action confirmation
capabilities.safety.description: Writes follow command risk policies; deletes and high-risk actions require one-time user confirmation.
configuration.botId.label: Bot ID
configuration.botSecret.label: Bot Secret
configuration.botSecret.description: The WeCom bot secret, encrypted by Poco.
